targets.expr: clamp_min(sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_expected{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])) - (sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_submitted_total{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])) or on(surface) (0 * sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_expected{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])))), 0)

panels.title: Diagnosis Matrix
panels.description: Surface-level funnel counts shown as one table. Expected is the planned jobs per selected surface; Submitted is the accepted create response count; Visible is work observed after that response; Target state is terminal completion. Submit failed is derived from expected minus submitted so early exits show up even when no explicit submit-failed counter is emitted.

panels.title: No Data Warning
panels.description: Warns when selected filters have no PerfPulse expected-job samples in the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Expected Jobs
panels.description: Planned work count across selected surfaces. Cron currently expects one job per surface; campaigns expect campaign.totalJobs per selected surface.

panels.title: Jobs Submitted
panels.description: Accepted create responses from the selected surface. This is a count; submission duration is measured separately as request start to create response.

panels.title: Jobs Visible
panels.description: Work observed through the selected surface after the accepted create response.

panels.title: Cleanup Failures
panels.description: Cleanup failures recorded by PerfPulse for selected filters.

panels.title: Surface Lifecycle Trend
panels.description: Lifecycle counts aggregated by surface for the selected filters. Prefer this over per-testid trends when testid is All.

panels.title: Target State Reached
panels.description: Terminal completion percentage by surface. Empty when no jobs reached a successful terminal state for the selected filters.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_expected{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])) - (sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_submitted_total{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])) or on(surface) (0 * sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_expected{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])))), 0) / clamp_min(sum by (surface) (last_over_time(k6_perfpulse_jobs_expected{testid=~"$testid",run_class=~"$runClass",profile=~"$profile",surface=~"$surface",scenario=~"$scenario",cohort=~"$cohort",job_profile=~"$job_profile",namespace=~"$namespace",campaign_type=~"$campaignType"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Target State Failures
panels.description: Target-state failure percentage by surface: submit deficit, visibility failures, and terminal completion failures divided by expected jobs for the selected run.

panels.title: Submission Latency
panels.description: Create request duration by surface, measured from request start until the create response returns. This does not include later visibility, admission, or completion time.

panels.title: Visibility Latency
panels.description: Post-submit visibility latency by surface, measured from accepted create response until the Job, Kueue Workload, or Skaha session is visible. This excludes submission duration.

panels.title: Completion Latency When Observed
panels.description: Post-submit completion latency for jobs that reached terminal success. Uses rate-based histogram queries so long campaigns populate the panel as completions arrive. Empty when no successful completions exist for the selected filters.

panels.title: Kueue Admission Latency
panels.description: Post-submit Kueue admission latency, measured from accepted create response until the Kueue Workload is admitted. This excludes submission duration.

panels.title: Cleanup
panels.description: Cleanup coverage and failure percentages by surface, divided by expected jobs. Cleanup failure is an event signal, so use the diagnosis table for exact counts.
